## Automated Tests Required

### Epic 06 Story 004 — Discovery Ledger Persistence — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/constellation/discovery-ledger-persistence_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-14: first-ever `shape_id` activation fires both `constellation_activated` AND `constellation_rune_discovered`
- AC-15: re-forming the same shape at a different anchor does not re-fire discovery
- AC-16: breaking and reforming the identical instance does not re-fire discovery; `get_save_data()`/`restore_save_data()` round-trip the ledger correctly

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A real save/load round-trip (not just direct `get_save_data()`/`restore_save_data()` calls in isolation) at `restore_order=24`
- Discovery Ledger surviving across a simulated mission boundary while the active-instance table does NOT persist (mission-scoped vs. playthrough-scoped distinction)

**Estimated test count**: ~4 integration tests

---

### Epic 06 Story 005 — Localized Search Scope & Performance Bound — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/constellation/localized-search-scope-performance-bound_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-17 (BLOCKING): recheck never calls `get_all_occupied_cells()` — reuse the existing `GridSpyDouble` (`tests/helpers/grid_spy_double.gd`, already has a call counter) rather than building a new double
- AC-25 (ADVISORY): derived radius reads `3`, boundary-inclusive at exactly Chebyshev distance 3
- AC-29 (ADVISORY): grid-too-small-for-shape produces no error, only absence of activation

**Edge cases to cover**:
- AC-30 (ADVISORY, perf, OQ-7 methodology still informal): 10-tower vs. 55-tower scene, ±20% tolerance band — reuse the same `Time.get_ticks_usec()` ad hoc methodology already validated for Tower Mastery's S6-05 prototype rather than inventing a new one

**Estimated test count**: ~4 integration tests (3 BLOCKING/ADVISORY-pass-fail + 1 informal perf smoke check)

---

### Epic 06 Story 006 — Placement-Only Formation & Edge Cases — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/constellation/placement-only-formation-edge-cases_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-18: `tower_removed` alone never completes a shape (only breaks)
- AC-19: `tower_destroyed` breaks an active instance regardless of mission phase, including `WAVE_ACTIVE`
- AC-27: N-1-then-remove-and-replace-elsewhere fires no deactivation (nothing was ever active)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A blocking (differently-tagged) tower's removal must not accidentally complete the shape it was blocking
- The re-placement-elsewhere case must trigger only its own fresh, independent, localized recheck — not resurrect any state from the original N-1 attempt

**Estimated test count**: ~3 unit tests

---

### Epic 06 Story 008 — Build Signature via Event-Payload Extension — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/tower-mastery/build-signature-event-payload-extension_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-07/AC-08/AC-09: cross-mission `build_signature` persistence via recycled `tower_id`, resume-not-restart on destroy-and-replace, no double-counting from redundant same-signature coverage
- AC-11/AC-12: `tower_placed`/`tower_component_equipped` handlers populate/recompute `_active_signature_by_tower` directly from the (now S7-01-extended) event payload — no separate query call
- AC-26: signature derived from the full 4-slot loadout, not archetype alone

**Edge cases to cover**:
- None of this story's ACs are automatable until S7-01's ADR actually lands and `TowerData`/`tower_placed`/`tower_component_equipped` are extended to match — confirm S7-01 shipped before treating any of these as passable, same caution the story's own Blocked-reason note already states

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests, contingent on S7-01

---

### Epic 06 Story 009 — Cell-Boundary Proximity Tracking — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/tower-mastery/cell-boundary-proximity-tracking_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-24: `mission_phase_changed → SCOUT` halts all accrual same-frame; `hero_position_changed` during SCOUT never changes `mastery_time`
- AC-25: out-of-bounds hero cell skips the `_signatures_in_range` recompute entirely, retains previous cache, never calls Grid with an invalid cell

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Transient edge-of-map hero position (camera pan) resolving to an out-of-bounds cell — must not crash
- Phase transition to SCOUT occurring mid-accrual (partial-frame leak check)
- Confirm this story replaces S6-10's test-injected `_active_signature_by_tower` seam with the real production wiring from S7-05

**Estimated test count**: ~4 unit tests

---

### Epic 06 Story 010 — Mastery Progress & Skill Unlock — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/tower-mastery/mastery-progress-skill-unlock_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-19: `mastery_time` sums correctly across mission boundaries (18 + 30 = 48 worked example)
- AC-20: `progress_percent` clamps at 100.0 for display even past threshold
- AC-21: `unlocked_skills[skill_id]` set `true` BEFORE `skill_unlocked` emits — order matters for same-frame idempotency
- AC-22: post-unlock accrual continues unbounded; `skill_unlocked` never re-fires
- AC-23: two different build signatures accrue independently and in parallel

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Same-frame re-evaluation after crossing threshold must not double-fire `skill_unlocked`
- No catalogue entry yet for a signature → `mastery_progress_updated` does not fire (valid silent no-op), not an error

**Estimated test count**: ~5 unit tests

*No formula gap — Formulas 1-3 are all explicit in the story's own Implementation Notes.*

### Epic 06 Story 011 — Cross-Mission Mastery Persistence — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/tower-mastery/cross-mission-mastery-persistence_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-10: persisted `mastery_time` reads correctly immediately after `restore_save_data()`, no live-tower dependency
- AC-13/AC-14: pause-not-reset on hero leaving range or sole tower destroyed, same-frame state update
- AC-15: accrual resumes automatically from the paused value once a matching-signature tower reappears
- AC-16/AC-17: `DEFEAT` outcome resets neither in-progress `mastery_time` nor a permanent `unlocked_skills` entry
- AC-18: orphaned `unlocked_skills` entry (unknown post-launch `skill_id`) retained, marked `UNKNOWN`, excluded from UI, load never blocks

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A real save/load round-trip at `restore_order=34` (not just direct method calls) — confirm the corrected restore_order (34, not the GDD's stale self-proposed 31) is what's actually registered
- `restore_order` sequencing relative to Hero (30)/Hero Skill Build (31)/Equipment Forge (32) if any of those are live in the same test's Autoload set

**Estimated test count**: ~7 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### S7-01 — Implement ADR-0008's Component-Loadout Architecture (catch-up, not a new decision)
**Verification method**: code review + live MCP verification of `duplicate_deep()` isolation
**Who must sign off**: godot-gdscript-specialist (implementation), lead-programmer (review)
**Evidence to capture**: the 4 component classes + `TowerBlueprintData` landed, `tower_system.gd`'s 9 read sites migrated, a live MCP test proving mutating one tower's component copy doesn't affect another tower sharing the same blueprint

Checklist:
- [ ] `FoundationComponent`/`WeaponComponent`/`FocusComponent`/`PowerComponent` + `TowerBlueprintData` implemented per ADR-0008's Amendment 2026-07-19 schema
- [ ] `duplicate_deep()` isolation live-verified via Godot MCP (this ADR's own Verification Required row has been open since 2026-05-19)
- [ ] Stories 008/009 (S7-05/S7-06) actually unblocked as a result — not just theoretically closable
- [ ] `constellation_eligibility_tag` relocated to `PowerComponent` with zero change to Constellation's own consuming code (S6-08's EventBus payload shape is unaffected)
- [ ] ADR-0008's write-access boundary (`tower-system-only`) is preserved, not reopened

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint:

1. Game launches to main menu without crash
2. New game / new session can be started
3. A mission can be launched, reach SCOUT, and a tower can be placed (baseline regression — Story 008's `TowerData`/EventBus payload extension touches the same placement path Sprint 6's `constellation_eligibility_tag` fix already modified once this sprint)
4. Constellation's Stories 004-006 do not regress Stories 001-003's already-passing behavior (persistence, search-scope, and edge-case logic all sit on top of the same active-instance/reverse-index structures)
5. Tower Mastery's Stories 008-011 do not regress Story 007's already-proven Hero-independence guarantee (AC-04/AC-05) — the real `_active_signature_by_tower` wiring replaces the S6-10 test-injected seam, a genuine risk point for silent coupling
6. Save / load cycle completes without data loss, specifically exercising Constellation's Discovery Ledger (`restore_order=24`) and Tower Mastery's `mastery_time`/`unlocked_skills` (`restore_order=34`) together in one round-trip
7. Performance is within budget — watch Constellation Story 005's own AC-30 concern and Tower Mastery's per-frame accrual loop under the same conditions Story 012 already measured in Sprint 6

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check`. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories (Constellation 004-006, Tower Mastery 008-011)
- [ ] S7-01's implementation (ADR-0008's component-loadout catch-up) lands and is live-verified before Stories 008/009 (S7-05/S7-06) are attempted
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced — specifically watch Constellation Stories 001-003 and Tower Mastery Story 007's already-passing test suites
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
